title: knowgov run folder record
description: What a run folder, runs/<subject id>/<stamp>/run.json, says of the run that wrote it (task-0127): the page's Runner writes it when the run starts (status running) and again when it ends (finished, status done or failed, exit_code); a run whose process could not start is failed with an error and no exit code. by names who asked: the page's buttons or knowgov-runs (mcp). Never a key, a token or the run's environment; log is the log's file name in the folder; source is the id the page's views read the folder by. Version 2 adds heartbeat_at (task-0128): while the run is under way the Runner rewrites run.json with it every 30 s, and a reader counts a running run.json as live only while it is within 120 s of the reader's clock; the page closes a stale one at start as failed, error 'page restarted'. A version 1 file has none, and its start stands for it. A change is additive or a new version. A folder from before it has none, and its readers infer as before.
